argv: SELECT 'decisions' AS stream,off,len,ts,label FROM decisions WHERE run_id='WJ0LTVSSDY61' UNION ALL SELECT 'brain' AS stream,off,len,ts,label FROM llm_calls_raw WHERE run_id='WJ0LTVSSDY61' AND src='brain' UNION ALL SELECT 'run-config' AS stream,off,len,ts,'config' AS label FROM run_config WHERE run_id='WJ0LTVSSDY61' UNION ALL SELECT 'runs' AS stream,off,len,ended AS ts,'finished' AS label FROM runs_raw WHERE run_id='WJ0LTVSSDY61' ORDER BY ts,stream,off
